tasks[].payload_instance_id.meaning: Optional identity of one physical container. Repeated use refers to that same object, not an instruction to duplicate it.
tasks[].payload_instance_id.precedence: An ordinary outbound task may first issue a previously unissued ID. Commitment claims that creation; after physical pickup or seeded storage the ID must be available at the requested source for reuse. Transit, removal and unconfirmed arrival do not permit recreation. Blank ordinary IDs receive unique generated identities. Return tasks normally require existing stock; internally generated staged and service continuations retain their specific policies.

corridors.auto_connect.meaning: Connect otherwise unconnected locations/lifts to the nearest corridor node when enabled.
corridors.auto_connect.precedence: Editor default is false; simulator fallback for raw JSON is true. Supply this value explicitly.

corridors.edges[].width_m.precedence: Falls back to building.default_corridor_width_m; endpoint doors can reduce it.

corridors.edges[].bidirectional.precedence: Default true; profile allowed edges still apply directionally.

corridors.nodes[].door_clear_width_m.meaning: Clear opening when has_door is true.
corridors.nodes[].door_clear_width_m.precedence: Falls back to building.default_door_clear_width_m. Restricts all incident edges.

corridors.nodes[].has_door.meaning: Treat the node as a door restriction.

building.default_corridor_width_m.meaning: Corridor width when omitted on an edge.
building.default_corridor_width_m.precedence: Default 2.4; explicit edge width overrides it.

building.default_door_clear_width_m.meaning: Door opening when omitted on a door node.
building.default_door_clear_width_m.precedence: Default 0.9; explicit node opening overrides it.

building.load_unload_time_sec.precedence: Default 20; consult location/action-specific logic for overrides.

locations[].max_concurrency.meaning: Simultaneous AMR service capacity at a location.
locations[].max_concurrency.precedence: Per-location limit; missing values use 999999 in the simulator.

task_generation.update_interval_sec.meaning: Interval between accumulation updates, retained through editor saves. Clock schedules and timeframe slots use separate exact calendar events.
task_generation.update_interval_sec.precedence: Simulator fallback 900 seconds; effective interval is at least 60 seconds. A final partial update occurs at the inclusive demand horizon. Resource waits and configured release staggering can delay assignment; runtime-dependent modes need wider verification.

task_generation.categories.*.scheduled_t.meaning: Daily clock occurrences for scheduled modes, with exact calendar release events. HH:MM:SS is normalised to HH:MM by the existing parser.
task_generation.categories.*.scheduled_t.precedence: Group/department override replaces category schedule. Effective release is adjusted to department opening, then weekday/fortnight gates apply. Effective times before run start are excluded; the end is inclusive. Empty times produce no clock occurrences.

task_generation.categories.*.enabled.precedence: Enabled department/group rules can run even when false; global disable still wins.

task_generation.categories.*.department_.precedence: Overrides category default; group membership suppresses standalone department override.

task_generation.categories.*.dropoff_zon.meaning: Wait for space or permit temporary overflow for compatible payloads.
task_generation.categories.*.dropoff_zon.precedence: Category-wide; department/group values are ignored. Default allow_temporary_overflow.

route_profiles.*.allowed_edges.meaning: Permitted directed corridor edges. Shared sections belong to each applicable route profile.
route_profiles.*.allowed_edges.precedence: Union with task allow-list; empty means unrestricted. Each multi-stop leg intersects effective permissions of onboard tasks; a disjoint intersection forbids travel. Graph direction and width constraints still apply.

amrs[].multi_stop_enabled.meaning: Enable sharing a journey across compatible payload slots; at least two slots and two eligible tasks are required.
amrs[].multi_stop_enabled.precedence: If omitted, simulator default is true when multiple payload slots exist. Batch groups retain route-profile/dirty-label compatibility. Each leg uses onboard permissions and oriented clearance; empty approaches remain unrestricted by payload rules. Greedy pickup-first ordering is not a complete feasible-tour search.

route_profiles.*.allowed_nodes.precedence: Union with task allow-list; empty means unrestricted.

route_profiles.*.allowed_lifts.precedence: Union with task allow-list; empty means unrestricted.

simulation.max_task_deferral_minutes.meaning: Maximum time from scheduled release to assignment.
simulation.max_task_deferral_minutes.precedence: Zero disables the limit; retrying does not restart the timer; idle returns excluded.

simulation.tick_rate.meaning: Not a validated physical integration timestep.
simulation.tick_rate.precedence: Do not use this value as a claim about simulation accuracy.

amrs[].speed_m_per_sec.precedence: Congestion/scenario factors may reduce speed; acceleration is not modelled.

amrs[].width_m.precedence: Required passage width is the larger of robot and oriented payload width.

payloads[].allowed_carry_orientations.precedence: Must also fit the AMR slot and its allowed orientations.
